recent.text: #NJDevils power play went 0-for-4 against the Jets, HC Keefe said that changes may not be "too far away". "Today, had a chance to make a difference and just a lot of the same of what we were seeing before we had a bit of a reset where we got better for a bit, but it's creeping
recent.author: Amanda Stein

recent.text: In other news, the Utica Comets won their fifth straight game tonight. The #NJDevils AHL team continues to roll as David Rittich earned a shutout. Xavier Parent, Lenni Hämeenaho, Jack Malone and Stefan Noesen all scored. Anton Silaev picked up two assists.
